credits.intro: gld is free, gratis and has no telemetry. It is written and maintained by Sat0r in his spare time, under the MIT license. If you use it every day, here is how to help it keep going.
credits.bugText: A precise reproduction is worth a fix.
credits.codeText: Fixes and ideas, as a merge request.
credits.donationNote: A donation is voluntary, with no account or middleman. Check the address before sending.

tunnel.loopback: gld is open on an address local to this computer: another device cannot reach it.
tunnel.lan: On the local network: start gld with --listen 0.0.0.0 and open it through the machine's IP (192.168.…).
tunnel.cloudflared: From another network, a quick trycloudflare tunnel (no account), then restart gld with --public-url set to the https://….trycloudflare.com address it shows:
tunnel.warning: All of gld becomes reachable from the Internet: turn on a token or accounts first, and stop the tunnel afterwards. The address changes on every run.

pair.title: Connect a device
pair.intro: On the phone or tablet, enter this code: the device signs in without a token or password. The code works only once.
pair.step1: On the device, open Glaude Code (the app or the browser) and tap “Connect this device”.
pair.step2: Type the code above, then “Connect”. The QR code signs in the browser the Camera opens, not the app.
pair.accountNote: The device gets a session of your account, listed and revocable in Profile › Sessions.

share.title: Share session
share.intro: Each guest gets their own single-use link, with their own name and mode.
share.copyFailed: Copy failed: select the link below.
share.singleUse: Whoever opens it first reserves it. Do not open it yourself: with host access it is refused without being spent; in local mode without a token, it is spent (without locking your interface). To test it, use a private window.
share.insecure: Connection is not HTTPS: the guest cookie is not secure.
share.loadFailed: Could not read the sharing state.
share.homesFailed: Could not read the config folder: link not generated.

invites.title: Shared session
invites.intro: The guests of all your shared sessions, their links and their pending messages.
invites.regenBody: The old link and this guest's connection will stop working.
invites.revokeBody: This guest loses access immediately and their queued messages are removed.
invites.closed: Session closed: messages will be sent when it opens.
invites.limit: At most ten invitations per session.
